description: Ask SPV for a document, as its "Solicitări" form does. SPV registers the request (the answer carries its request_id) and posts the document as a RASPUNS SOLICITARE message a minute or two later: call await_reply with the id. The type must be one list_document_types offers this identity, with the fields it requires; a field the type does not take is refused before anything is sent. Free, and changes nothing at ANAF.

cif.description: The tax id to request for, one of `identities`; default the form's first (the account holder).

month.description: The reporting month, for the types that take one.

month_from.description: The first month, for the types that take a range (Neconcordante D394).

month_to.description: The last month of that range.

pui.description: The PUI, for the Fisa Rol types.

registration_number.description: A filing's registration number, for Duplicat Recipisa (e.g. INTERNT-123456789-2026).

type.description: The document type, as list_document_types names it (case and diacritics ignored).

year.description: The reporting year, for the types that take one (Duplicat declaratie unica: 2025 = the return filed in 2025).

name: request_document
title: Request a document
